outcome: Psychiatric symptomatology (general psychopathology, positive, negative, cognitive, behavioural, motor, emotional symptoms, total psychopathology score)
cohort: The study included 152 adults born very preterm (before 33 weeks' gestation) and 96 term-born controls.
finding: Very preterm individuals demonstrated elevated psychopathology in positive, negative, cognitive, and behavioural symptoms compared with full-term controls, and their psychiatric risk was associated with lower IQ.
